BILINGUAL.EN: A Simulator for Digital Circuits
BILINGUAL.JA: デジタル回路のシミュレータ

BILINGUAL.EN: Designing complex digital systems, such as computers, is an important engineering activity. Digital systems are constructed by interconnecting simple elements. Although the behavior of these individual elements is simple, networks of them can have very complex behavior. Computer simulation of proposed circuit designs is an important tool used by digital systems engineers. In this section we design a system for performing digital logic simulations. This system typifies a kind of program called an event-driven simulation simulationevent-driven event-driven simulation, in which actions (events) trigger further events that happen at a later time, which in turn trigger more events, and so on.
BILINGUAL.JA: コンピュータのような複雑なデジタルシステムの設計は、重要な工学的活動です。デジタルシステムは、単純な要素を相互に接続することで構築されます。個々の要素の振る舞いは単純ですが、それらのネットワークは非常に複雑な振る舞いを示すことがあります。提案された回路設計のコンピュータシミュレーションは、デジタルシステムエンジニアにとって重要なツールです。この節では、デジタル論理シミュレーションを行うシステムを設計します。このシステムは、 event-driven simulation simulationevent-driven イベント駆動シミュレーションと呼ばれるプログラムの典型的な例です。イベント駆動シミュレーションでは、アクション（イベント）がさらなるイベントを引き起こし、それが後の時点で発生し、さらにそれがまた別のイベントを引き起こす、というように続きます。

BILINGUAL.EN: Our computational model of a circuit will be composed of objects that correspond to the elementary components from which the circuit is constructed. There are wire, in digital circuit wires, which carry signal, digital digital signal digital signals. Adigital signal may at any moment have only one of two possible values, 0 and 1. There are also various types of digital function box, in digital circuit function boxes, which connect wires carrying input signals to other output wires. Such boxes produce output signals computed from their input signals. The output signal is delaydelay, in digital circuit delayed by a time that depends on the type of the function box. For example, an inverter inverter is a primitive function box that inverts its input. If the input signal to an inverter changes to 0, then one inverter-delay later the inverter will change its output signal to 1. If the input signal to an inverter changes to 1, then one inverter-delay later the inverter will change its output signal to 0. We draw an inverter symbolically as in figure. An and-gate and-gate, also shown in figure, is a primitive function box with two inputs and one output. It drives its output signal to a value that is the logical and (digital logic) logical and of the inputs. That is, if both of its input signals become1, then one and-gate-delay time later the and-gate will force its output signal to be 1; otherwise the output will be 0. An or-gate or-gate is a similar two-input primitive function box that drives its output signal to a value that is the logical or (digital logic) logical or of the inputs. That is, the output will become 1 if at least one of the input signals is 1; otherwise the output will become0.

BILINGUAL.EN: We can connect primitive functions together to construct more complex functions. To accomplish this we wire the outputs of some function boxes to the inputs of other function boxes. For example, the half-adder adderhalf half-adder circuit shown in figure consists of an or-gate, two and-gates, and an inverter. It takes two input signals, $A$ and $B$, and has two output signals, $S$ and $C$. $S$ will become 1 whenever precisely one of $A$ and $B$ is1, and $C$ will become 1 whenever $A$ and $B$ are both 1. We can see from the figure that, because of the delays involved, the outputs may be generated at different times. Many of the difficulties in the design of digital circuits arise from this fact.
BILINGUAL.JA: プリミティブ関数を接続することで、より複雑な関数を構築できます。これを実現するために、あるファンクションボックスの出力を別のファンクションボックスの入力に配線します。例えば、図に示す half-adder adderhalf 半加算器回路は、一つの ORゲート、二つの ANDゲート、一つのインバータで構成されています。二つの入力信号 $A$ と $B$ を受け取り、二つの出力信号 $S$ と $C$ を持ちます。$S$ は $A$ と $B$ のうちちょうど一方が1 のときに 1 になり、$C$ は $A$ と $B$ の両方が 1 のときに 1 になります。図からわかるように、遅延が関係するため、出力は異なるタイミングで生成される可能性があります。デジタル回路設計の難しさの多くは、この事実から生じます。
